context_purpose: Research office confirms a participant is eligible and that two separately issued claims refer to the same person, while keeping the consent file defensible.

norm_violation_today.reason: Holding ID and insurance numbers beside health information in a consent file is plausible for an IRB but exceeds what an eligibility join strictly needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Consent requires a signature and real name, and audit or adverse-event follow-up needs the study to reach the person, so full identity cannot be dropped.

transmission_check.reason: Research ethics rules likely require identifiable signed consent and records, and I cannot say whether they require ID numbers specifically.

context_purpose: An app limits promotions to genuinely new users to protect its marketing budget from repeat-account abuse.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting driver licence photos, selfies and device IDs to enforce a coupon rule goes beyond what a once-per-person check needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A pseudonym cannot stop people with several prepaid SIMs or recycled numbers, and cannot support fraud, payment or safety checks that some services (scooters) need.

transmission_check.reason: No legal duty forces the app to collect these for a coupon, though scooter rental may separately require a driving licence.

context_purpose: Emergency and outage-response bodies need to identify households that depend on powered medical equipment so they can be prioritised.

norm_violation_today.reason: Addresses, bills and medical certificates of vulnerable households are passed around many volunteers on paper, wider than the eligibility step needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Responders still need the address and equipment details to dispatch help, so membership alone only covers the enrolment step.

transmission_check.reason: Disaster-response duties likely require locations for dispatch, though not necessarily for volunteer-level eligibility checks.

context_purpose: A childcare centre protects other children and staff by confirming a returning child is no longer contagious.

norm_violation_today.reason: Staff need only fitness to return, yet receive the diagnosis or visit record and circulate photos in messaging groups.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little: a dated not-contagious attestation covers the return decision, though it cannot serve the reporting of notifiable diseases to health authorities.

transmission_check.reason: Rules on infectious-disease reporting and return-to-school may need the diagnosis in some cases, and I cannot confirm which.

context_purpose: A landlord, platform or subsidy agency wants evidence that a micro-business is live and has enough turnover to be a reliable counterparty.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full statements expose suppliers, customers, personal withdrawals and balances when only a turnover figure is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cash sales never reach the bank, and tax filings are the authoritative turnover record, so the proof understates and may not satisfy subsidy rules.

transmission_check.reason: Subsidy programmes may require specified documents and I cannot say whether a signed aggregate would be accepted.

context_purpose: A building manager grants standing access only to couriers who look experienced and reliable, to protect residents and deliveries.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full app screenshots with earnings, plate, home zone and sometimes ID copies go far beyond a delivery count and rating.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A platform statistic does not bind the person at the door, so a separate identity check is still needed.

transmission_check.reason: No law I know of requires full screenshots; this is the building's own access policy.

context_purpose: A building controls entry so that only staff currently sent by a vouching contractor are admitted, with a record for accountability.

norm_violation_today.reason: Recording an ID number for building access can be justified for accountability, but paper logbooks that are easily leaked are weak retention practice.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The building often wants a name for accountability and incident follow-up, which an unlinkable roster proof removes.

transmission_check.reason: Building security rules may call for identifying individuals, and I cannot say what the law requires.

context_purpose: A school or after-school operator confirms a household qualifies for a fee reduction before granting it.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full utility bill with address, meter and consumption is kept when only subsidy status is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little, if the discount roll is accepted as a proxy, but it is not an official welfare eligibility record.

transmission_check.reason: Schools normally rely on the district office's certificate, so whether a utility roll is accepted is a policy choice I cannot confirm.
